title: Apply one Proposal
description: Applies one Proposal to the FieldWorks project as one unit of work, using its latest Trial; Autonomous mode requires a project-declared gate and the newest Trial's green verdict for its required words, current policy and live project state. The optional --message must be one line of at most 128 characters. Text summarizes counts and points to the full effects file; --effects prints it, --json keeps the full effects array, and MCP never applies or offers a Readiness override here.
